items.title: BotBase for Operators: A clearer path to joining Cloudflare's directory of bots and agents
items.summary: Bot operators now have a home in the Cloudflare dashboard to manage submissions. This update adds submission status tracking, submission editing, and a behavior model so operators can accurately declare how their bots use content.

items.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
items.summary: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet.
